name: J&T Global Express Limited
summary: J&T Global Express Limited, an investment holding company, offers integrated express delivery services in the People's Republic of China, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Mexico, Brazil, and Egypt. The company offers parcel sorting, line-haul transportation, dispatching services, and other related network management services; network services consist of system support and training, and general network arrangement and oversight services; and cash on delivery services.
